node.grade.title: Grade
node.stack.title: Grade Stack
action.stack_add_description: Add a Grade to this stack.
action.match_white_description: Set the source white point to D65.
action.reset_directions_description: Reset balance, spread, and heading controls.
action.reset_tone_description: Reset the tone curve to its default mapping.
action.new_grade_description: Create a new Grade or make an independent copy of the selected Grade.
action.bake_description: Bake this output into a managed float Image. Shader Image and UV bakes use Cycles CPU. Compositor bakes use the CPU compositor.
action.invalidate_image_description: Notify Grade bakes after a script changes this source Image's pixels.
action.unlink_bake_image_description: Stop using the managed Bake Image while keeping it available to other readers.
action.unlink_grade_description: Clear this node's Grade and restore default values.
action.add_grade_description: Add a Grade node to the current graph.
action.convert_grade_description: Convert between node-owned and datablock-owned Grade settings.
action.convert_to_node_description: Copy the selected Grade into this node for independent editing and animation. Use default settings when no Grade is selected.
action.convert_to_datablock_description: Create a new Grade datablock from the current frame's values and remove this node's Grade animation. Undo restores the animation.
action.add_stack_description: Add a Grade Stack node to the current graph.
action.new_stack_grade_description: Create a Grade for this stack entry.
tooltip.toggle_gizmo: Show or hide the Perceptual Grade Gizmo in this editor.
tooltip.toggle_vectorscope: Show or hide the Linear vectorscope in this editor.
scope.appearance.title: Appearance Distribution
status.bake_stale_engine: Bake may be outdated (render engine or device changed)
status.bake_stale_source: Bake may be outdated (source data changed)
status.bake_stale_route: Bake may be outdated (inputs could not be checked)
status.bake_stale_canvas_size: Bake may be outdated (render canvas size changed)
status.bake_stale_unverified: Bake may be outdated (no reference for current inputs)
error.autokey_failed: Could not create an animation keyframe
tooltip.exposure: Exposure in stops. +1 doubles linear RGB values.
tooltip.source_x: CIE x coordinate of the source white point.
tooltip.source_y: CIE y coordinate of the source white point.
tooltip.cr_balance: Exposure balance across the Cyan-Red axis. Positive values darken red and brighten cyan; negative values reverse the effect.
tooltip.yb_balance: Exposure balance across the Yellow-Blue axis. Positive values darken blue and brighten yellow; negative values reverse the effect.
tooltip.cr_spread: Change the Cyan-Red reference displacement from the working white point. -100 collapses the direction to white; +100 doubles it.
tooltip.yb_spread: Change the Yellow-Blue reference displacement from the working white point. -100 collapses the direction to white; +100 doubles it.
tooltip.cr_heading: Counterclockwise angle of the Cyan-Red axis in the CIE xy plane.
tooltip.yb_heading: Counterclockwise angle of the Yellow-Blue axis in the CIE xy plane.
tooltip.black_compression_nits: Reversibly compress near-black appearance values without clipping them.
tooltip.input_shadows: Inputs at this nit value map to the neutral Shadows anchor.
tooltip.input_midtones: Inputs at this nit value map to the same perceptual lightness as 18% grey.
tooltip.input_white: Inputs at this nit value map to the neutral White anchor.
tooltip.input_highlights: Inputs at this nit value map to the neutral Peak anchor.
tooltip.fit: Higher values bring the curve closer to its control points and concentrate each point's influence.
tooltip.muted_gain: Chroma gain limit toward neutral colors, in stops.
tooltip.vivid_gain: Chroma gain limit for vivid colors, in stops.
tooltip.saturation_crossover: Input saturation where the muted and vivid gains meet halfway in stops.
tooltip.shadow_chroma: Additional shadow chroma gain, fading smoothly to zero at the Tone crossover.
tooltip.highlight_chroma: Additional highlight chroma gain, fading smoothly to zero at the Tone crossover.
tooltip.tone_crossover: Absolute J_A crossover between the shadow and highlight chroma adjustments.
tooltip.peak: Neutral luminance target for the highlight anchor.
tooltip.enabled: Include this Grade in the Stack.
tooltip.bake_image: Managed floating point Image used by the baked output.
tooltip.use_bake: Use the managed Bake Image instead of the live Grade output.
tooltip.bake_width: Width for a UV or native compositor Bake.
tooltip.bake_height: Height for a UV or native compositor Bake.
action.reset_color_description: Reset all Stage 3 Warp controls to their defaults.
tooltip.adaptance_a: Neutral a destination for selective Adaptance at this tone anchor. Both targets are limited together before a cone-response pole.
tooltip.adaptance_b: Neutral b destination for selective Adaptance at this tone anchor. Both targets are limited together before a cone-response pole.
tooltip.adaptance_half_saturation: Saturation C/|J_A| at which Adaptance has half influence; higher saturation is protected.
tooltip.web_chroma: Relative chroma change stored as a log2 ratio at this Warp handle.
tooltip.web_hue: Stored hue displacement from the ungraded Rec.709 handle, in degrees. Neighboring handles move automatically to retain at least 4 degrees of separation.
tooltip.hue_limited: The evaluated hue is adjusted to preserve cyclic order with at least 4 degrees between handles. Stored animation values and keyframes are unchanged.
tooltip.adaptance_limited: The evaluated Adaptance pair is reduced radially before a cone-response pole. Stored animation values and keyframes are unchanged.
tooltip.web_scale: Scale J_A and C together at this Warp handle, in stops.
